d: Long, straight platinum blonde hair with a center part and long bangs frames a youthful yet mature face with sharp, narrow pale-green eyes. The slender build is dressed in a layered white and teal tunic with gold trim and gold pauldrons, cinched at the waist by a gold-buckled belt. Visible non-human traits include long pointed elven ears and large, dark brown, curving horns protruding from the head. BODY COLOR: pale ivory LEGS: plantigrade with human-style feet wearing black boots
